description: Sound in the games: play the earshot Chibi sound set first for the game events, with an MP3 copy and a per-browser format choice, and the synthesized sounds as the fallback; approved library takes replace set files later
deviation_notes: Recorded 2026-10-14 as the follow-up of audio_sfx_library_20261013 (its plan task: event mapping, format, preload budget). Amended 2026-11-22 to the PM decisions: the earshot set sounds/chibi/*.ogg is the first source, the wrapper writes an MP3 copy for each sound, the set needs no credits screen, and the files ship with the APK release through a PM hand-off folder.
